title: Tenant mail transport falls back to the app transport without tenant config
detail: tenantMailTransport returns null when the channel context carries no tenant config, instead of throwing on every send, so the channel uses the app transport as documented.

title: Email sending offers a platform default and an own SMTP server
detail: The provider field is labelled "Send via" with the options "Platform sending (default)" (empty, saved as "") and "Own SMTP server"; the SMTP fields show only while the own server is picked.

title: The deprecated mailFoundationFeature constant is removed
detail: mailFoundationFeature was kept next to createMailFoundationFeature() for one release. Mount the feature by calling createMailFoundationFeature().
migration: Run bun kumiko-upgrade --apply. It replaces mailFoundationFeature with createMailFoundationFeature().
